subject.title: feat(ledger): add immutable action history core

question: Should ClawSweeper adopt this v1 immutable action-ledger schema and storage/replay contract as the foundation for workflow instrumentation?
rationale: The patch establishes permanent data, privacy, filesystem, configuration, and producer-identity boundaries that tests cannot select on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Accept the v1 contract
options.body: Approve the schema and storage architecture, with integrated workflow replay proof required before this PR and its dependent integration land.

options.title: Narrow the commitment
options.body: Require an experimental or version-negotiated namespace, or a smaller initial schema, before production workflows become permanent writers.

options.title: Pause the ledger stack
options.body: Hold this PR and its dependent integration until maintainers select another durable action-history architecture.

recommendation.title: Accept the v1 contract
recommendation.body: Approve the schema and storage architecture, with integrated workflow replay proof required before this PR and its dependent integration land.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current-main ownership across the affected workflow, state, policy, and identity surfaces.
